metadata.title: Burn-in stress test: fix calculator + formatter bugs
metadata.goal: Fix all 6 failing tests across 2 modules

capability_overlap: burn-in test — no overlap check needed

tasks.title: Fix calculator bugs (add, subtract, divide)
tasks.prompt: Fix all bugs in src/calculator.py: 1. add() subtracts instead of adding — change return a - b to return a + b 2. subtract() adds instead of subtracting — change return a + b to return a - b 3. divide() crashes on zero — add: if b == 0: raise ValueError("Cannot divide by zero")

tasks.title: Fix formatter bugs (name, currency, list)
tasks.prompt: Fix all bugs in src/formatter.py: 1. format_name() returns "last first" — swap to return f"{first} {last}" 2. format_currency() needs comma thousands and 2 decimal places: return f"{symbol}{amount:,.2f}" 3. format_list() uses str() — change to: return ", ".join(items) if items else "" Also: replace 'import logging' with 'from loguru import logger'.

tasks.title: Create integration test for edge cases
tasks.prompt: Create tests/test_integration.py with edge case tests: - test add/subtract with floats (e.g., add(1.5, 2.5) == 4.0) - test divide returns float (divide(7, 2) == 3.5) - test format_currency with negative amounts - test format_list with single item returns just that item All tests must pass. Import from src.calculator and src.formatter.
